site.title: Atomic Scaling Ventures — Backing Ambitious Founders from Seed to Scale
site.description: Atomic Scaling Ventures is an angel investor and startup accelerator backing technology founders from seed to Series A — with capital, the Atomic Scaling operating method, and an operator network across North America, Europe and Asia.

team.name: Ludovic Bodin
team.title: Founder & General Partner
team.bio: Ludovic Bodin is a three-time entrepreneur, two-time unicorn investor and author of Atomic Scaling. He founded three companies in e-commerce, travel and gaming — AuRestaurant.com, Macau.com and Cmune, whose UberStrike reached 30 million players — exiting two. As an investor he was first investor and board member at Chiliz (exited at $1.5B) and an early backer of ASIG ($2.5B), with a portfolio spanning Silicon Valley, Europe and Asia. He is the creator of the 3P3R Method® and founder of BOBIC Generational Wealth.

criteria: Seed to Series A technology companies
Scalable digital business models — software, platforms, marketplaces and digitally-distributed products
Capital-efficient teams that grow revenue faster than headcount
Founders open to operating with the Atomic Scaling 3P3R method
